question: The Khelo India University Games 2021 was organised in ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bengaluru** hosted the Khelo India University Games 2021.
 
• The Khelo India University Games is a national-level multi-sport event for university athletes in India, aimed at promoting sports and identifying talent at the university level.
 
• The event is part of the Khelo India initiative, which seeks to foster a strong sports culture in the country.
 
• Bengaluru, the capital city of Karnataka, has a rich history of hosting various national and international sporting events, making it an ideal location for the games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Khelo India Programme** was launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in 2018 to revive the sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• It includes various components such as the Khelo India School Games, Khelo India Youth Games, and Khelo India University Games.
 
• The programme provides financial assistance for the development of sports infrastructure and the training of athletes.
 
• Khelo India University Games 2021 featured a wide range of sports, including athletics, basketball, football, badminton, swimming, and more.
 
• The event saw participation from numerous universities across India, showcasing the sporting talent of the country's youth.
